name: 知识问答
tagline: 十道题，四个选项，答得快得分高。
description: 免费玩知识问答：地理、历史、科学、体育等十道题，答得越快得分越高。可以独自挑战，也可以和朋友比赛。
about: Trivia is a quick quiz of ten questions, from geography, history, science, nature, sport, art and books, music, and food and drink. Every question has four answers and 15 seconds.

A right answer scores 100, 150 or 200 points, for an easy, medium or hard question: half for being right, and half that shrinks as the seconds pass. A wrong answer, or none, scores nothing. Each game has three easy questions, four medium and three hard, easiest first.

Play alone for your best score, or race friends in a room on the same ten questions. The questions are written for kefche in English and Bulgarian, the same in both, and each was checked against an encyclopedia.
howToPlay: Choose a topic: Mixed for questions from every category, or one category.
After a 3-2-1 countdown, the first question appears with four answers and a 15-second bar.
Tap or click an answer, or press 1 to 4. The faster a right answer, the more points.
The right answer shows for a moment, then the next question comes. After ten, see your score and every answer.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap an answer.
Keyboard: press 1, 2, 3 or 4, or Tab to an answer and press Enter or Space.
tips: Read all four answers before you choose: half the points are for being right.
If you don't know, rule out the answers you're sure are wrong.
Pausing gives up the question on screen, so finish it first.
Play a single topic to learn it: the end of each game shows every right answer.

faq.question: Is Trivia free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Where do the questions come from?
faq.answer: They're written for kefche, in English and Bulgarian, and each answer was checked against an encyclopedia.

faq.question: How are points worked out?
faq.answer: An easy question is worth up to 100 points, a medium one 150 and a hard one 200. Half comes for a right answer, and the other half shrinks over the 15 seconds.

faq.question: Can I play with friends?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a room and race on the same ten questions; the most points win.

faq.question: Which languages can I play in?
faq.answer: English and Bulgarian for now. More languages are coming with their questions.
